dedupe_keys.name: empirical uav to lte air to ground channel measurements

description: This release provides empirical air-to-ground radio measurements for cellular-connected unmanned aerial vehicles. Mehran Behjati and collaborators publish more than 95,000 raw observations and approximately 11,060 filtered samples, with received power, signal quality, path loss and spatial geometry features. The repository includes a filtered workbook, a raw-data archive and Python scripts for cleaning records and deriving two- or three-dimensional distances and antenna-relative angles. Geographic coverage and measurement dates are not stated in the inspected README; the Zenodo version 1.0.0 release is dated 22 November 2025. Files are publicly available without charge under GPL 3.0 in the canonical archive. A limitation is incomplete external documentation of detailed field units and filtering thresholds, so preprocessing conventions need inspection before combining the measurements with another channel model. Simulation uses include fitting UAV-to-cellular propagation models and testing geometry-based radio predictors. No related catalogue resource was established as the same campaign. The triple-layer machine-learning model is available only by request and is excluded from the released-resource claim. No workbook, archive or model was downloaded and the preprocessing scripts were not run.
